name: electric-state
description: Find official electronic music festival set times, upcoming festival editions, festivals by date and place, and upcoming bookings for individual artists with Electric State.

interface.longDescription:
Plan your festival experience with Electric State. Look up official set times by festival, artist, or day; find upcoming festival editions; see which festivals are on between two dates, near a city or in a state or country; and see which festivals an electronic music artist is playing next.

Set times are transcribed from festivals' official published schedules and returned on the festival's local clock, with stage names and source graphics when available. Cancelled editions are taken out of the catalog. Results include links to Electric State for more event details.

This connection reads public festival information. No account or API key is required. It cannot buy tickets, change schedules, or access a user's passport or saved events. Historical booking analysis, aggregate rankings, and the full Scene Index archive are separate products and are not available through these tools. If a schedule has not been published or an artist has no listed upcoming bookings, the tools report that limitation.
defaultPrompt: What festivals are on in California in the next two weeks?
What festivals is FISHER playing next?
Are set times available for EDC Orlando?

positive.description: Find upcoming editions of a named festival series.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for EDC and return the currently listed upcoming editions with their dates and locations, plus the Electric State link. Do not invent editions or promise a fixed number of results; upcoming data changes over time.

positive.description: List upcoming festivals in a date range and place.
positive.prompt: What electronic music festivals are on in California in the next two weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_festivals with state California, starting today and ending 14 days later. Return the currently listed festivals and shows with their dates, venues, cities, and Electric State links. Do not invent events or promise a fixed number of results; upcoming data changes over time. Do not supplement with web-search listings, which may include cancelled editions.

positive.description: Return an individual artist's upcoming festival bookings.
positive.prompt: What festivals is FISHER playing next?
positive.expected_behavior: Look up FISHER and show upcoming festival bookings in date order with festival names, dates, locations, and the artist's Electric State link. Do not present these results as a complete concert tour or historical booking archive.

positive.description: Read a published schedule for a specific festival edition.
positive.prompt: Show me the published Breakaway Philadelphia schedule for September 11-12, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Look up Breakaway Philadelphia and present its published September 11-12, 2026 sets grouped by day, including artist names, start and end times, and stages. State that times use America/New_York, and include the official schedule graphic and Electric State link. Make clear that this is the requested past edition.

positive.description: Filter an official schedule to one artist and preserve the local time zone.
positive.prompt: What were Tiesto's set time and stage at Breakaway Philadelphia in September 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Look up Breakaway Philadelphia with the artist filter Tiesto or Tiësto. Return Friday, September 11, 2026, 10:45 PM to midnight on the Main Stage, using the festival's America/New_York local clock. Include the official graphic and Electric State link.

negative.description: Handle an artist with no listed upcoming bookings.
negative.prompt: Where is Nonexistent Artist Xyz playing next?
negative.expected_behavior: Report that no upcoming festival bookings are listed for this name. Do not invent an artist, dates, or events, and do not claim this proves the artist has never performed.

negative.description: Handle a real festival whose set times have not been published.
negative.prompt: What are the set times for EDC Las Vegas: Dusk, May 14-16, 2027?
negative.expected_behavior: Look up the festival using slug edc-las-vegas-weekend-1-2027. If set times are unpublished, state that they are not available yet and provide the Electric State link. Do not invent times or say the festival does not exist. If the schedule is published by the review date, report only the actual returned schedule.

negative.description: Respect the boundary between public festival tools and the separate historical analytics product.
negative.prompt: Give me the top 100 most-booked electronic artists of all time, with their exact festival booking totals.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that these tools do not provide all-time rankings or aggregate booking totals, and direct the user to https://developer.electricstate.app for the separate Scene Index product. Do not invent totals, fabricate a leaderboard tool, or claim upcoming artist bookings answer the historical ranking request.

review.commerce_description: This MCP connection provides public festival information and links to Electric State. It does not accept payments, sell goods, place orders, or purchase tickets.

publication.release_notes: New plugin created at OpenAI's request so the MCP server can be connected during setup. Same hosted endpoint (https://api.electricstate.app/mcp), no authentication. Adds the read-only list_festivals tool (festivals between two dates, near a place or in a state or country, from Electric State's own catalog) to the listing and review cases, alongside search_festivals, get_set_times and get_artist_schedule.
